TrainableParametersOrCompute: Efficient adaptation with reduced trainable parameters
Strength: Reports 10-30% relative WER/CER improvement with Viterbi decoding in 13 of 14 languages across 3 datasets; use as direct ASR evidence for adapter-based PEFT.
Limitation: Needs comparison across more foundation models.
BestUseCase: Best when compute/storage constraints limit full fine-tuning.

Paper: Qian et al.
AdaptationType: Soft language-code tuning, prompt tuning, LoRA, EWC, fine-tuning
DataCondition: Adding low-resource language to multilingual ASR
Strength: Direct fine-tuning can improve the new target language most but may degrade existing language capability; adaptation-parameter methods preserve existing language ability with a target-language performance trade-off.
Limitation: Trade-off remains unresolved.
BestUseCase: Best when adding a new low-resource language without damaging existing languages.
